Messages.Author: The Cadaverous Verger
Messages.Body:
So there I was, building a deck around Mata Hari (come now, who isn't?)
and a thought occurred to me.

How does she exactly interact with the burn option cards? Does her
special ability count as "mandatory" so that if she is in play, I can't
discard eg. Tracker's Marks with the burn option? Or does her special
only "activate" when I want to play cards that have requirements?

Either of these possibilities seems possible and logical rules-wise.

--CV

Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:


I believe you can ditch those cards. She can PLAY card as whatever, but
she is NOT OF whatever.
Correspondingly she can equip with Erebus Mask, but she'll never benefit
from its effects. (So she'd better make use of the option to 'burn' the
card in the first place :) )

Sten During
